8.description: [Pending Restart] Path of Ascension: Building your Class Fantasy, and Reach Level 10! can now be turned in at the callboard.

0.description: Fixed an exploit where you could double-equip some "unique-equipped" item.

[Requires Launcher Update] Modified the default fonts to support Cyrillic and Chinese characters. You should be able to read messages with those characters now rather than a bunch of boxes or ? marks. 

However, english clients are still unable to type or paste Cyrillic or Chinese text at this time.

5.description: [High-Risk] Fixed an issue where Sanguine Naxx recipes required an incorrect and no longer obtainable item to craft. (Required Restart)

7.description: Fixed an issue where the recent changes to Wind Ragers Rampant Tornado caused it to have 10% AP scaling instead of the intended 20%.

3.description: [Launcher] Fixed issue causing certain users to be stuck in an infinite update loop.
[Launcher] Fixed some visual glitches related to the "Confirm" buttons and the realm selection page on the store.

1.description: [Pending Restart] Fixed an issue where Righteous Defense shared cooldown with taunt abilities.

3.description: Fixed the issue causing closed Bug Reports to not display the reasoning behind their closure. Previously it would just say "Closed", now it will for example show "Closed - Fixed", "Closed - Unable to reproduce" etc.

7.description: Fixed an issue where the Master of Elements mystic enchant was not working as intended. It now properly increases the mana gained by the Master of Elements capstone effect by 5%.
Lightning Blade and Thunder Slam from the Thunder Slam enchant now reduce the cooldown of Thunder Clap by 2 seconds, down from 3.

Fixed an issue where the "Sweeper" buff, gained from consuming your eruption stacks was increasing the AoE damage dealt by 25% and the single target damage by an additional 25% instead of providing 40% damage increase to the main target.
'Lava Sweep now deals 85% Weapon Damage from 90%.
Midnight Flames' Shadow Kindling debuff now increases the damage of Pyroblast by 7% down from 10%.
Wind Rager now gives 2% attack speed per stack (from 3%) and 20% when fully stacked (from 30%). This change is intended to bring it more in line with other comparable Legendary enchants.
Fixed an issue where Wind Rager's Rampant Tornado wasn't abiding by its target caps and had uncapped AoE. It will now correctly abide by the 6 target cap.

0.description: [Malganis] Resilient Constitution now reduces damage taken in PvP by 48%, changed from 45%. (With new gear from Naxxramas, overall damage is increased by a good amount.)

1.description: [Pending Restart] Summoner's Armor can now be used when you don't have an active pet (the bonus will apply to your pet after you summon it).
[Pending Restart] Summoner's Armor now increases the spell damage done by your pet by 3%, changed from adding flat spell damage.
[Mal'Ganis] Demonic Warlock Armors are now 2 AE down from 4 AE for the remainder of Vanilla.
[Mal'Ganis] Elemental Mage Armors are now 2 AE down from 4 AE for the remainder of Vanilla.
[Mal'Ganis] Shaman Weapon Enhancements are now 2 AE down from 4 AE for the remainder of Vanilla.
[Pending Restart] - Fixed an issue where Chilling Touch from the Dominate Undead family of Skeletal Mage had incorrect range. It now has the indeded 20 yard range.

[Pending Restart] - Fixed an issue where previous change to Furious Anger from the Dominated Undead family of Wights did not get pushed properly. This spell will now have the intended cooldown of 45 seconds, down from 60, and duration of 30 seconds, up from 10 seconds.

5.description: Reduced the PPM of Nightfall (axe) from 2.5 PPM to 2 PPM. This provided far too much value in Vanilla and disproportionately affected 25 man raids more than 10 man raids and overall providing too much power to a raid group.

Reduced the PPM of Nightfall (axe) from 2 PPM to 2.5 PPM. This provided far too much value in Vanilla and disproportionately affected 25 man raids more than 10 man raids and overall providing too much power to a raid group.

7.description: Fixed an issue where target cap for Execute (Disembowel) from Blood and Guts did not get increased. The ability will now correctly hit 3 targets, up from 1.
[Pending Restart] - Fixed an issue where the Mystic Enchant Harbinger of Plague did not increase the plague damage of Disease Cloud from the Dominate Undead family Zombie.

1.description: [Malganis] - New Ability: Summoners Skin - Empowers your pet, increasing your pets critical strike chance by 2% and increasing your pets spell damage by a flat amount (increased further by level).

[Malganis] - Demon Skin, Fel Armor and Summoners Skin is now obtained all together through a new spell bundle called: Demonic Warlock Armors.

This spell bundle provides dynamic options without overt costs to having these options. Previously all spells combined would have cost 6 AE and 6 Blue Ability Gems is significantly reduced at 4 AE & 2 Blue Ability Gems.

[Malganis] - Mage Armor, Ice Armor and Molten Armor is now obtained all together through a new spell bundle called: Elemental Mage Armors.

This spell bundle provides dynamic options without overt costs to having these options. Previously all spells combined would have cost 6 AE and 6 Blue Ability Gems is significantly reduced at 4 AE & 2 Blue Ability Gems.

[Malganis] [Pending Restart] - Rockbiter Weapon, Windfury Weapon, Flametongue Weapon, Frostbrand Weapon are now obtained all together through a new spell bundle called: Shaman Weapon Enhancements. (Like Poisons)

This spell bundle provides dynamic options like poisons without overt costs to having these options. Previously all spells combined would have cost 8 AE and 6 Blue Ability Gems and 1 Epic this spell bundle is significantly reduced at 4 AE & 2 Blue Ability Gems.

0.description: Fixed an issue where the Arcane Fortitude capstone was applying a modifier more spells than listed in the tooltip.
[Discord Changelog Updates] - The Obsidian Worldbreaker is a mount now obtainable through the Nightmare, Ironman and Resolute Challenge.

(Manual Install) Mega download links were updated to correspond to the latest patches, if you are experiencing issues with your game malfunctioning and you are *not* using the launcher, please download and update with these.
Call of the Spirits is now Common from Uncommon.
Call of the Elements is now Common from Uncommon.
Call of the Ancestors is now Common from Uncommon.

1.description: [Pending Restart] Savage Defense is now always removed by 1 hit from players.
[Pending Restart] The Arcane and Nature damage increase in Furor no longer requires Moonkin Form and is now always active.

3.description: [Website] Improved Mythic+ leaderboards. You are now able to filter entries based on the instance they took place in. This should make it easier to measure yourself against others running the same instance. More improvements to this specific category will be coming soon.
[Website] Re-designed the backend of the Leaderboards to improve the performance of loading entries in tandem with improving development time

0.description: [Freepick] Abolish Curse is now 1 rare down from 2.
[Freepick] Abolish Disease is now 1 rare down from 2.
[Freepick] Abolish Poison is now 1 rare down from 2.
[Freepick] Pounce is now Common. Down from Rare. It is still gated by Prowl being rare.
[Freepick] Garrote is now Common. Down from Rare.

1.description: [Pending Restart] - Emberstone can now also trigger from Scorch.
Regrowth now heals for 8% less. Nature's Splendor now increases the healing of Regrowth by 5/10/15%, changed from 2/4/6%. (Resulting in no overall change if you have 3 points in Nature's Splendor.)
Holy Shock is now a common ability, changed from rare.
Penance is now a common ability, changed from rare.
Wild Growth is now a common ability, changed from rare.
Regrowth is now a common ability, changed from rare.
The recent tamed undead and demon ability additions are now properly live.
[Pending Restart] Fixed an issue where the Lone Wolf buff didn't apply.

7.description: [Pending Restart] - In addition to its old effects, Controlled Burn now also causes your Scorch on Conflagrated targets to deal additional damage.

[Pending Restart] - Fixed an issue where Nature's Rejuvenation did not affect the healing over time effect from Seed of Life. The base spell power scaling of Seed of Life healing over time effect has been reduced equally, meaning no change as long as you use the talent.
[Pending Restart] - Increased the physical damage reduction from Fiery Fervor from the Mystic Enchant Templar of Flame to 8%, up from 6%.
[Pending Restart] - Execute (Disembowel) from the Mystic Enchant Blood and Guts can now hit up to 3 targets, up from 1.

[Pending Restart] - Soulbender has been slightly reworked, it is now an Epic Mystic Enchant and now reads: Each tick of Drain Soul now accumulates Soul Energy. Dealing damage with Shadowburn consumes all of your Soul Energy stacks to heal nearby party members and increases your healing done by 2% for each stack of Soul Energy consumed. This effect lasts for 10 seconds. In addition, the cooldown of your Shadowburn is reduced by 4 seconds.

[Pending Restart] - Clarified all mechanics of Plague Bearer in the tooltip of the Mystic Enchant and its spells and effects, and you now only learn Festering Strike if you know Bear Form. In addition, Plague Bearer's Rabies effect from dealing damage with Mangle (Bear) now has level scaling on the physical damage taken debuff. The effect at level 60 is unchanged, and at level 70 is slightly increased.

0.description: Overhauled and implemented threat scaling for tanks in the dungeon scaling system. This prevents issues from low level tanks not being able to hold threat from higher level party members.
Overhauled Classic Dungeon Heal scaling on Alar and Area 52 to fix some issues with high levels healing lower levels.

3.description: [Website] Added new indicator for spell rarity allocation on the Builder's "Overview" tab to mimic the in-game one.
[Website] Fixed issues where all talents would cost 2 AE on the Al'ar Website Builder.

0.description: [Alar & Malganis] - [Pending Restart] Veteran Nanny will now require 1 of the 3 pets to be complete.
Fixed an issue on Alar that could consume the new weapon enchantments from the exclusive 2v2 rating.

A Warden of the Horde, Back to the Oprhanage, A warden of the Alliance, from the Childrens Week quest chain is now a daily repeatable quest and will allow you to obtain all three pets from the Veteran Nanny on one character. Additionally, these quests (if previously completed) are now reset.
Orphan Whistle timers are now updated to match the new Childrens Week event timer. All current whistles have had 3 days added to their duration timer.
Fixed an issue where some achievements would not count with your Orphan Out, even though the Orphan was indeed out.

[Pending Restart] - "Bad Example" will now be complete when you finish just ONE of the criteria listed below when your orphan is out. (this achievement was originally created in WotLK and only 1 recipe is available in vanilla and only two in TBC. This will make this achievement completable in both, TBC & Vanilla)
[Pending Restart] - "School of Hard Knocks" will now be complete when you finish THREE of the FOUR required criterias to complete the achievements.
[Pending Restart] - "Hail to the King" will now be completable by slaying Thrall or Bolvar with your orphan tagging along instead of requiring King Ymirron.

7.description: Fixed an issue where Predatory Nature was failing to give combo points.

1.description: [Malganis] Fixed an issue where Metamorphosis Demon Charge did not share cooldowns with other gap closers.

7.description: [Pending Restart] Unchained now slows nearby targets for 50% instead of rooting. (After the recent buff of Unchained the root ended up being too overwhelming to face as it made it too hard to follow someone blinking away from you.)

[Pending Restart] Arcane Shielding now decreases the mana lost per point of damage taken when Mana Shield is active by 10%, changed from 13%. (Heavy investment into Mana Shield made it too powerful for too low of a mana cost for the builds that could afford it).

0.description: [Pending Restart] [Malganis] Players with Spirit Primary Stat now heals for 5% less in 2v2 arenas. (While healers should have a strong place in 2v2 they have been overperforming a bit.)

1.description: [Pending Restart] Thunderstruck now reduces the cooldown of Shockwave by 4/7/10 sec, changed from 5/10/15 sec. (After several small incremental buffs to Shockwave and the recent rework of Tooth and Nail, Shockwave ended up being too powerful and overshadowing other stuns in group PvP.)

[Pending Restart] Brambles now silences for 2 sec when casting Entangling Roots, changed from 3 sec. (This talent provided too much control for certain builds, making them frustrating to play against.)

[Pending Restart] Unrelenting Assault now reduces magical damage and healing by 10/20%, changed from 15/30%. (Arms builds are doing well overall and especially in 2v2 where specifically their healing reduction is very powerful.)

0.description: The Childrens Week event has been extended for 3 days. A following changelog coming soon will reduce the number of achievements required and make some the achievements completable in Vanilla / TBC. This rework will be akin to other achievement reworks and will allow you to reap the rewards once completed.

1.description: Fixed an issue where Blood Horror could trigger multiple times from the same attack (which would lower its duration due to diminishing returns).
[Felforged] Fixed an issue causing Felforged players to learn a higher rank of Cauterizing Flame than intended.

0.description: [Felforged - Requires Launcher Update] Dying will no longer reset your hotbars in Felforged mode.

1.description: [Felforged] Your starting 4 ability drafts will now properly bypass rarity chances, meaning it will be significantly easier to obtain spells like Charge or Sprint in your starting 4 spells on Felforged.
[Felforged] Fixed various spell rarity issues where spells that should have a rarity did not or had the wrong rarity.
[Felforged] Fixed an issue where some core damaging spells had a rarity in Felforged mode. These core damaging spells are now properly common spells.

7.description: Fixed an issue where the Divine Fury Mystic Enchantment would not increase the damage done to targets affected by your Righteous Flames Holy Fire (DoT) effect.
Fixed an issue where the Divine Fury Mystic Enchantment would never further increase your damage more than 2%. Having 3 Enchantments will now correctly increase your damage done by 6%.

Fixed an issue with the Divine Fury Talent and Mystic Enchantment that could cause other Mystic Enchantments to not stack. This also could cause no benefit from other Mystic Enchantments that increase specific ability damage such as the Sealed in Flame enchant.

5.description: Gutgore Ripper now deals 30% reduced damage against players. It previously did not have a PvP modifier.

6.description: [Area 52 - Malganis - Alar] [Mythic Affixes] Convention of the Elements now reduces the players damage dealt by 25% down from 40% and each Elemental Power now increases its represented elements damage dealt by 150% down from 300%.
[Area 52 - Malganis - Alar] [Mythic Affixes] Avenger no longer reduces creatures damage taken. Avenger is now a enrage effect and can be dispelled.

[Area 52 - Malganis - Alar] [Mythic Affixes] Last Will has been replaced with Avenger. Avenger causes a dying creature to rally nearby allies, increasing their damage dealt for a short duration, stacking up.
[Area 52 - Malganis] [Mythic Affixes] Mrglrlrlrr no longer effects summoned creatures and bosses.

0.description: Rounded out the flat damage increase per level for Multiple Tamable Undead & Demon pets that they would receive in PvP. The damage for these pets remain unchanged at level 50 & above. This means that the damage increase received will not be so drastically favorable to certain level brackets and more of a general increase that does not seem to immediately halt once hitting level 50.
[Requires Launcher Update] Further polished the realm select screen.
Felforged Experience gain has been increased to 850% on Monster Kill, Quest Turn in & Profession and 1600% on PvP kill.
Felforged players now deal increased damage to resolute players from levels 20-59.
